facts.text_zh: 执行 VTBS 20R RNP 进近需要注意。ATKIN 之后转 5 边的 航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165,intercept final course 20R,report established.”注意 管制是要求先建立20R RNP 的五边，而不是许可 RNP 进近,注意 证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以 RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP 进近不 允许执行“高截获”程序。
facts.text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

facts.text_zh: 02L进近 常指挥保持3 边航向，控制前后机距离，之后 指挥直飞BATEM 或ABVER，在引入02LRNP 进近计划时MCDU会提 示选择VIA BATEM 如果没有选择VIA 计划上看不到BATEM 点。
facts.text_en: During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

facts.source_text_en: During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

facts.text_zh: 02L落地后使用F W 跑道外等，使用W 穿越跑道Straight ahead D4 换频 121.95会直接给停机位和滑行路线 例如 S123 D 滑行 G 前等，继续滑行 T18 或 T19 进位。机场细则中规定：02L/20R落地后不允许在快速脱离道停留去等待滑行指令，若无 指令，02L 落地后应延 F、W、02R 外等，20R 落地后应延 F、Z、20L外等。
facts.text_en: For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

facts.text_zh: 曼谷的 s126机位的进位引导经常跳变，会出现瞬间从 2 米调到 0 然后出现 stop，ok 后又会跳变出数字，有滑过或者未 滑行到位的风险，机组和机务都多次遇到此类情况。
facts.text_en: At Terminal S126 in Bangkok, the approach guidance system frequently exhibits abrupt switching: it may instantaneously shift from 2 meters to 0, then display "Stop"; after pressing "OK," the number may switch again, posing a risk of overshooting or failing to reach the correct position. Both flight crew and ground maintenance personnel have encountered this issue on multiple occasions.

facts.text_zh: 巡航时在曼谷区域，近期多触发 NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT,NAV BKUP SPD FAULT，随后出现两侧GPS PRIMARYLOST，机组应当提前熟知技术通告，飞行全过程中知晓最低安全高度，按技术通告处理。
facts.text_en: During a cruise in the Bangkok area, the aircraft recently experienced multiple failures including NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT and NAV BKUP SPD FAULT, followed by GPS PRIMARY LOST on both sides. groups.chinese_preview:
我是来自飞行十五中队的副驾驶段洋硕，目前技术级别A2，晋级日期1月13日，本阶段经历时间93小时，起落21个，近90天起落8个，近3个月已运行过曼谷素旺那普机场，近3个月已运行过上海浦东机场，上一次实际操纵落地为10月1日上海浦东机场。

上一次飞行中机长/教员对我优缺点的评价（作为PF/PM各取最近一次）：
上一次作为PF教员评价：30尺以下带杆量欠一点；着陆后快速脱离道口前及时减速至30节以下；作为PM机长评价：增加SOP熟练度，标准喊话声音大一些。

典型不安全事件：

曼谷素旺那普机场：

受地面温度影响+ 易发生进近剖面低+ 着陆距离远等事件+ 请机组注意。

上海浦东机场：

曾因低高度鸟击导致雷达罩处损伤超标。

曾发生更改跑道后输错飞行计划事件。

核心威胁：

曼谷素旺那普机场：

部分机位推出过程中会临时停下给出启动发动机的指令，后续会继续牵引飞机，机组应该注意听清指令，不要盲目刹车，否则有导致剪切销断裂的风险。

如预计经过沥青道面，不建议单发滑行。

滑行道不平整如果 N1-50%时仍无法滑出，需要拖车。

机场标高：8ft。

BANGKOKBLUEPORT(BANG-KOKBLUEPORT)，频率129.050，如果我们的机组人员在素万那普机场有任何疑问，例如需要TOBT/TSAT/停机位方面的信息，或者需要飞行计划方面的协助，或需要提出特殊要求，请通过此频率联系他们。

地面运行时，应确保 Mode S 应答机可用，并且打开应答机（例如：非STAND-BY或 OFF位置），设置给定的Mode A 代码（离港飞机，来自于收到的放行许可；进港飞机，继续原代码直至完全在停机位停好）。

H6与 H3,H5与 H2为同一条滑行道注意识别。

在加油的时候，素万那普机场要求不要上客。如果必须在加油的时候上客，要先通知机场准备消防车。具体可询问春秋机务！。

有减噪程序，除非影响飞行安全，在1900-2300UTC时间内不得使用大反推。

为减少跑道占用时间，飞行员应确保在收到起飞许可后能立即开始起飞滑跑。

离地自动脱波119.25。

使用20L 跑道起飞时容易滑错，因为 E1，E2非常近，而且E 滑行道有延伸段去货机坪，请机组务必注意。

01跑道会使用 B12离场。

19 号起飞离场一般用Selka1J 离场，起飞后可能会指挥取消限制直飞Selka，然后可能指挥直飞 SAV。

巡航时在曼谷区域，近期多触发 NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT,NAV BKUP SPD FAULT，随后出现两侧GPS PRIMARYLOST，机组应当提前熟知技术通告，飞行全过程中知晓最低安全高度，按技术通告处理。

通讯失效后按航图或机场细则执行。

空域异常繁忙，间隔较小，可能加入等待与标准等待或有出入注意证实。

军演频繁，常涉及改航路，请对照飞行计划检查。

减噪程序：见机场细则。

释压程序：见放行单。

无线电失效程序：机场细则及杰普逊手册有具体实施方法。

上海浦东机场：

从BK 进场，若向北运行时，通常用西跑道 35L 号，若向南运行时，通常东跑道 16L。

进场程序较多，有时会临时更改，在非繁忙时刻通常会有直飞，机组做好预案。

浦东向南进近过程中曾多次触发 TA/RA 告警，请机组进近准备时做好相关预案，按照手册记忆项目程序执行。

浦东 17R/35L 跑道，ATC 可能指挥短切五边或较晚发布盲降许可，机组做好预判并提前做好能量管理，积极沟通，按需接受 ATC 雷达引导的指令。当需要实施"从上方截获下滑道"程序时，严格遵循 SOP 要求，如无法满足稳定进近标准，果断复飞或中止进近。

近期发生多次浦东机场 168 号停机位，因上坡和单发原因油门加至地面最大可用推力仍不能移动飞机，而关车申请拖车。请注意在此类停机位的进位速度。

浦东机场细则要求，AD2.20，3.2.4"进港航空器机组发现地面滑行引导车后关闭滑行灯，跟随地面滑行引导车滑行"。

机组在进入设置目视泊位引导系统的机位时，发现有疑问的引导指示，或进入由人工引导入位的机位时发现地面接机人员未就位（尤其是着陆后临时更换机位时常发生），应当立即停止滑行，及时通报 ATC，并应当保持发动机运转，等待后续处置。

地面运行换频频繁，换频指令与滑行等待位置较近，机组注意，防止滑错/滑过线。

机场标高：13ft。

跑道信息：16L/34R（3800m×60m）；16R/34L（3800m×60m）；17L/35R（4000m× 60m）；17R/35L（3400m×60m）。

PAPI信息：16L：跑道左侧入口内 454 米，3°，MEHT 20.9m；34R：跑道左侧入口内 455 米，3°，MEHT 21.5m；16R：跑道左侧入口内 452 米，3°，MEHT 21.9m；34L：跑道左侧入口内 452 米，3°，MEHT 22.4m；17L：跑道左侧入口内 464 米，3°，MEHT 21.7m；35R：跑道左侧入口内 464 米，3°，MEHT 22.5m；17R：跑道左侧入口内 452 米，3°，MEHT 21.4m；35L：跑道左侧入口内 452 米，3°，MEHT 21.0m。

浦东机场驱鸟炮声音较响，机组不要产生惊吓效应。

groups.english_preview:
I am Duan Yangshuo, a First Officer in Flight Squadron 15. My current technical level is A2, and my promotion date is January 13. In this qualification stage, I have 93 hours and 21 takeoffs and landings. I have completed 8 landings in the last 90 days. I have operated at both VTBS and Shanghai Pudong International within the past three months. My most recent landing as PF was at Shanghai Pudong International Airport on October 1.

Latest PF/PM feedback: as PF, the instructor noted that below 30 ft I should use slightly more aft-stick input and, after landing, decelerate below 30 kt before entering the rapid-exit taxiway; as PM, the captain noted that I should improve SOP proficiency and make standard callouts more audible.

Typical unsafe events:

Suvarnabhumi Airport:

Affected by ground temperature, prone to low approach profiles, long landing distances, etc. Crew attention required.

Shanghai Pudong International Airport:

Low-altitude bird strike incidents have caused excessive radome damage.

Flight-plan data-entry errors occurred following runway re-assignment.

Core threats:

Suvarnabhumi Airport:

Special complex procedures: During the deployment of some aircraft positions, the system may temporarily halt to issue an engine startcommand, after which itwill resume aircraft traction. The crew must carefully heed the instructions and avoid sudden braking, as this could risk shearing pin fracture.

Single-engine taxiing is not recommended when the taxi route is expected to include asphalt pavement.

If the skidway is uneven and the vehicle stillcannot be moved out when the N1-50% threshold isreached, a tow truck is required.

Airport elevation: 8 ft.

On-site/Dispatch Frequency: BANGKOKBLUEPORT (BANG-KOKBLUEPORT), Frequency 129.050. Should our crew members have any inquiries at Suvarnabhumi Airport—such as requests for TOBT/TSAT/landing slot information, flight planning assistance, or special requests—please contact them via this frequency.

During ground operations, ensure the Mode S transponder is operational and activated (e.g.,not in STAND-BY or OFF position). Set the designated Mode A code (for departing aircraft, use the code from the received clearance; forarriving aircraft,maintain the original code until fully parked in the apron).

Note that H6 and H3, as well as H5 and H2, are on the same taxiway.

Suvarnabhumi Airport prohibits boarding during refueling. Ifboarding is necessary, notify the airport in advance to prepare fire trucks. For details, contact Spring Airlines Maintenance.

Noise reduction procedures are in effect. The use of heavy reverse thrust is prohibited between 1900 and 2300 UTC unless it compromises flight safety.

To minimize runway time, pilots must ensure they can begin taxiing immediately upon receiving the takeoff clearance.

Automatic wave separation from the ground 119.25.

When using the 20L runway for takeoff, there is a high risk of taxiing errors due to the proximity of E1 and E2 runways, and the E taxiway's extension to the cargo apron. Crew members must exercise caution.

Runway 01 will use B12 for departure.

For departure on the 19th, the Selka1J is typically used. After takeoff, the airtraffic controller may cancel the restricted direct flight to Selka and then direct a direct flightto SAV.

During a cruise in the Bangkok area, the aircraft recently experienced multiple failures including NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT and NAV BKUP SPD FAULT, followed by GPS PRIMARY LOST on both sides. The crew should be thoroughly familiar with the technical notice, maintain awareness of the minimum safe altitude throughout the flight, and follow the technical notice for handling.

In case of communication failure, follow the airchart or airport regulations.

The airspace is abnormally busy with short intervals, and the waiting time may differ from standard waiting periods. Please verify this.

Frequent military exercises often involve route changes. Please check against the flight plan.

Noise reduction procedure: See airport regulations.

Pressure relief procedure: Refer to the release form.

Radio Failure Procedure: Specific Implementation Methods inAirport Regulations and Jepperson Manual.

Shanghai Pudong International Airport:

For BK arrival: during north-bound operations, RWY 35L (western runway) is normally assigned; during south-bound operations, RWY 16L (eastern runway) isnormally assigned.

Multiple arrival procedures are in use, with ad-hoc amendments possible. Direct-to clearances are common during off-peak periods. Maintain contingency plans.

Multiple TA/RA alerts have been recorded during south-bound approaches into Pudong. Prepare contingency measures during approach preparation and execute memory-item procedures per aircraft manual.

For RWY 17R / 35L, ATC may assign short base-leg vectors or issue ILS clearance at a late stage. Anticipate such scenarios, conduct proactive energy management, maintain active communication and accept ATC radar vectors as required. When performing “glideslope capture from above” procedure, strictly comply with SOP. Ifstable-approach criteriacannot be satisfied,execute missed approach or discontinued approach without hesitation.

Several recent incidents occurred at Stand 168: due to uphill gradient and single-engine taxi condition, aircraft could not move even with maximum available ground thrust, requiring engine shutdown and tow-in service. Control taxi speed when docking atstands with such gradients.

Per Pudong Aerodrome Instructions AD2.20, 3.2.4: “Upon sighting marshalling vehicle, arriving crews shall switch off taxi lights and follow the marshalling vehicle”.

When taxiing towards stands equipped with Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS): stop taxi immediately if receiving ambiguous guidance indications. When entering stands with manual marshalling, stop taxi if ground marshalling personnel are not on-site (frequently encountered after ad-hoc stand change post-landing). Notify ATC promptly, keep engines running and await further instructions.

Frequent frequency changes occur during surface movement. Frequency change points are geographically close to taxi holding positions. Exercise vigilance to prevent taxi routing errors or overshooting holding lines.

facts.text_zh: 浦东 17R/35L 跑道，ATC 可能指挥短切五边或较晚发布盲降许可，机组做好 预判并提前做好能量管理，积极沟通，按需接受 ATC 雷达引导的指令。当 需要实施"从上方截获下滑道"程序时，严格遵循 SOP 要求，如无法满足稳 定进近标准，果断复飞或中止进近。
facts.text_en: For RWY 17R / 35L, ATC may assign short base-leg vectors or issue ILS clearance at a late stage. Anticipate such scenarios, conduct proactive energy management, maintain active communication and accept ATC radar vectors as required. When performing “glideslope capture from above” procedure, strictly comply with SOP. Ifstable-approach criteriacannot be satisfied,execute missed approach or discontinued approach without hesitation.

facts.text_zh: 机组在进入设置目视泊位引导系统的机位时，发现有疑问的引导指示，或 进入由人工引导入位的机位时发现地面接机人员未就位（尤其是着陆后临 时更换机位时常发生），应当立即停止滑行，及时通报 ATC，并应当保持发 动机运转，等待后续处置。
facts.text_en: When taxiing towards stands equipped with Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS): stop taxi immediately if receiving ambiguous guidance indications. When entering stands with manual marshalling, stop taxi if ground marshalling personnel are not on-site (frequently encountered after ad-hoc stand change post-landing). Notify ATC promptly, keep engines running and await further instructions.
